dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-dorsal and lateral sections display several 'O' and 'C' shaped rings characterized by high-intensity light perimeters (~5-10 pixels wide) surrounding dark, low-intensity centers with sharp gradient transitions at the outer edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of asymmetrical, solid high-intensity light pixels are densely concentrated along the ventrolateral line and near the pectoral flipper insertion, lacking internal gradient cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the central body region form an obtuse triangle. A series of four smaller high-intensity blobs in the anterior neck region form a compact irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: The mid-lateral field exhibits a reticulated appearance where the high-intensity boundaries of multiple macro-annuli merge to form an interconnected mesh-like pattern.
